data.objective: Deliver a discoverable desktop-only interactive frontend prototype for release windows, version applications, workflow progress, baselines and analytics using fictional session mock data without backend or database changes.

requirements.statement: Provide one configuration-management entry with window, application, baseline and analytics views.
acceptance: All four views are reachable after login
View switching preserves module context
counterexample: A view is reachable only by typing a hidden URL
Switching views resets the selected project context

requirements.statement: Use one fictional data model for all lists, details, workflow progress, baselines and charts.
acceptance: Session operations update dependent views
Reset restores deterministic initial data
counterexample: The application count differs between the list and analytics
Reset keeps records created earlier in the session

requirements.statement: Demonstrate scenario derivation, conflict handling and core application actions without claiming persistence.
acceptance: Conflict dialog names delivery units, versions and application numbers
Prototype status remains explicit
counterexample: The user manually selects the derived scenario
A toast claims a durable server save

requirements.statement: Reuse existing RDDMP UI and theme patterns and cover asynchronous display states.
acceptance: Loading, empty, failure, forbidden, submitting, readonly, conflict and long-text states are visible
Desktop light and dark themes remain readable
counterexample: A failure renders an empty white panel
Long content covers the operation column

requirements.statement: Keep the prototype reversible and isolated from Java, Flyway and platform-private services.
acceptance: No server or migration file changes
Removing the module, route and menu injection fully rolls back the prototype
counterexample: The prototype requires a Flyway menu seed
Removing the route leaves backend or database artifacts

invariants: One application contains one physical subsystem and at least one delivery unit
Scenario is derived rather than directly selected
Charts and detail views derive from the same session mock data
Prototype operations never imply durable persistence
constraints: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Element Plus and existing dependencies only
Desktop-only acceptance exception inherited from REQ-20260814-021
No Java, Flyway, real workflow, attachment, notification or external access changes
Development occurs on local rokey as explicitly requested
non_goals: Persistent uploads, exports or application data
assumptions: Existing authentication routes can append a uniquely keyed prototype node without replacing server menus
Existing shared UI and ECharts dependencies cover the prototype
The formal release module will later replace session Mock operations through stable APIs
decisions: Use a single configuration-management entry with four in-module views
Use frontend-only session Mock and explicit prototype labeling
Do not modify backend or database
Implement directly on local rokey per user instruction
